request: Hey Claude, I just added the "podcast-guest-pitching" skill. Get me booked on hiking and backpacking podcasts. Find shows that are still active and big enough, write my one-sheet and the pitches, set up the tracker, and tell me what my last three episodes brought in.
business: Wrenfield Provisions, an online store selling lightweight meals for backpackers (invented example)

guest.name: Lena Marsh
approved_facts: started Wrenfield Provisions in 2023 in her garage in Bend, Oregon
hiked the Pacific Crest Trail in 2019 and the Continental Divide Trail in 2021
developed every recipe herself with a food scientist
worked for nine years as a dietitian before starting the company

topics.title: Eating well on the trail at half the weight
topics.takeaway: how to plan a day of trail food that weighs under 1.5 pounds and still covers 3,000 calories

proof.claim: Wrenfield Provisions meals average 125 calories per ounce

topics.title: From a garage to 2,900 orders a month
topics.takeaway: how a solo founder grew a food brand by selling to one community first

proof.claim: Wrenfield Provisions grew from 40 orders in its first month (March 2023) to 2,900 orders in September 2026

topics.title: Resupply plans that survive a thru-hike
topics.takeaway: how to plan mail drops and town stops so food never runs out or goes to waste

proof.claim: Wrenfield Provisions shipped 1,150 resupply boxes to hikers on three long trails in 2026

offer.promo: 15% off the first order with the show's code
